context: Evaluates whether the model uses ScreenGetAll to retrieve all connected monitors and correctly forwards the resulting Promise. The key challenge is knowing the ScreenGetAll function name and the exact shape of the Screen objects it returns (isCurrent, isPrimary, width, height).

checklist.name: ScreenGetAll used
checklist.description: ScreenGetAll from @wailsapp/runtime is called inside getScreens

checklist.name: Promise forwarded
checklist.description: getScreens returns the Promise<Screen[]> that ScreenGetAll returns without re-wrapping or modifying the resolved value

checklist.name: Screen shape documented
checklist.description: The implementation or its TypeScript types correctly reflect that each Screen object has isCurrent, isPrimary, width, and height properties
